headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense. Harris II hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs, while Martín Pérez pitched 5 strong innings with 10 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Victor Vodnik of the Colorado Rockies, who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation. Other notable injuries include Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, who was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, with a low back strain.

The Tampa Bay Rays made a notable trade, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock. The Los Angeles Dodgers also made a trade, acquiring LHP Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Marlins 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense. Harris II hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs, while Martín Pérez pitched 5 strong innings with 10 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Kevin Kelly earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players contributing to the win. JJ Bleday, Sal Stewart, and Spencer Steer were among the Reds' impact hitters, while Alec Bohm and Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 5-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Shane Baz leading the way on the mound. Gunnar Henderson and Pete Alonso were among the impact hitters for the Orioles, while Samuel Basallo and Junior Caminero also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rays Make Key Trade Addition**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays acquired 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. Dunn joins the Rays in a trade that brings new depth to the team's infield.
